V1.title: Giuseppe Pitrè, La vita in Palermo cento e più anni fa, Volume I
V1.publication: posthumous national edition, edition date unverified from witness

method: Direct reading of Gutenberg Pitrè Palermo volumes I–II; source lines are HTML text line locators, NOT original printed folio or archival manuscript page. Most 18th/early 19th century events compiled retrospectively and often secondhand or drawn from diarists. 1950 edition of volume II explicitly identified; NOT falsely counted as original 1881 Spettacoli or 1900 Feste patronali. Actions often nested inside one extended ceremony; no distinctness, independent source corroboration or liturgical authority certified.
